The sibling `..._rerun` directories hold only mm_gate.json and mm_uuid_check.json, i.e. preflight stubs with no outcomes, request or decision log, so they are NOT the scored cells.
source_cells._input_stack_decoding_match: the two cells are the SAME arm, the SAME code revision and the SAME posted knobs (16 devices, 1200 s, 40:40:20, lh_req, ss2, epg, per-frame, reask 30 s, tag _L3_epg_rq30) at two different SEEDS, so they are not an arm-versus-arm comparison and no stack or decoding difference is claimed or needed. Where a committed figure from ANOTHER arm is cited (always-cloud-fcfs at seed 7, edf at seed 7) it is used only as an independent reading of a TRACE-DETERMINED quantity (history_tokens), which is identical across arms by construction.

The INVALID rows are E24, E24b and the other pre-protocol simulator rows, none of which is cited here.

measured_safety_factor.what_the_ratio_is: observed engine first-token time divided by the committed D162 model's prediction on the ENGINE-REPORTED uncached and queued-ahead token counts, for every recall question actually SENT in the two committed covex-v6-fair-c5attr cells (seeds 5 and 7). Both sides measured; the ratio is a model error, not two predictions compared.
measured_safety_factor.why_not_tuning: the ratios come from the RUNG-3 BASE's own committed cells, not from rung 4's cells. Same practice as D180 to D182, which derived the D179 floors from committed covex-v6-base cells.
measured_safety_factor.sample_caveat: n = 5. At this n the nearest-rank q90 IS THE MAXIMUM, and the linear-interpolation q90 is 1.74398. The nearest-rank value is the one in force: it is D125's own convention for kappa and it is the CONSERVATIVE direction, since a larger factor puts the latest safe start EARLIER and so cannot cause the lateness this factor exists to prevent. Five rows is a real limitation on how well the tail is characterised and it is not presented as more than it is.

committed_kappa_it_replaces_on_this_path.source: cf_margin.safety_factor(cf_cost.load_residuals()), q90 on a held-out-BY-ARM split of cf_service_residuals.json
committed_kappa_it_replaces_on_this_path.coverage: it COVERS the 1.3856 low end of the measured range and DOES NOT COVER the 1.8721 high end, which is the gap this factor closes

self_inflicted_loss_column._claim: how many DEFERRED QUESTIONS would have missed the 3 s deadline under the measured bias. D191 names this as the column that can turn a pass into a real harm, so it is here and not in a footnote.
self_inflicted_loss_column.arithmetic: overrun = (bias - safety_factor) x predicted_service, so it is at or below zero for every bias at or below the factor. That is why the factor is the q90 and not the median.

GATE_A_dry_s4_report.cell: covex-v6-cf-c5attr, dry, seed 4, 16 devices, 1200 s, posted knobs, 1x memory, clean checkout

item_2_slack_used_per_deferral_s.note: all six values distinct, so this is a distribution and not a constant; the unit is seconds of the question's own slack spent waiting

item_3_predicted_u_against_ENGINE_REPORT.VERDICT: NOT MEASURABLE IN A DRY CELL, and that is itself a reason to stop before cells
item_3_predicted_u_against_ENGINE_REPORT.why: a dry cell has no engine, so there is no engine-reported uncached count. `last_telemetry_cached_tokens` is identically 0 in every decision (rd_u_telemetry_won = 0, rd_u_built_won = 60), so on the NOT-COLD branch max(built, telemetry) collapses to built and u equals u_built_only EXACTLY on all six deferral candidates. The telemetry half of the D186 / r1 correction is therefore CONSTANT (zero) dry: Rule 2's `unexercised` for that sub-link. It is implemented and reads the right quantity; it cannot vary without an engine.
item_3_predicted_u_against_ENGINE_REPORT.what_DOES_vary_dry: the COLD guard. rd_u_cold = 28 and rd_u_not_cold = 60, and u differs from u_built_only on exactly the 28 COLD decisions, where built-only UNDERSTATES u by 81,920 tokens in total. So the correction is not inert dry, but only one of its two halves is exercised.
item_3_predicted_u_against_ENGINE_REPORT.external_register: the committed engine-reported uncached figures for these same lagging devices are 8,215 and 14,516 (robo001, seed 5) and 4,181, 313 and 1,921 (robo004, seed 7), d190_recall_lag_diagnosis.json. The six deferral candidates here predict 5,410 to 7,390, which is inside that range but is NOT the same quantity on the same opportunities and is not offered as agreement.

item_4_would_have_missed_3s_under_the_me.THE_ZERO_IS_A_TAUTOLOGY_NOT_A_MEASUREMEN: the safety factor in force IS the maximum of the five measured biases (1.8721), so the overrun at that bias is identically (1.8721 - 1.8721) x service = 0.000000 for every deferral, by construction. Section 4a of the pre-registration says in advance that a tautology does not pass this gate, so the sensitivity below is what decides.
item_4_would_have_missed_3s_under_the_me.MARGIN_IS_ZERO: every deferral sits EXACTLY on its own deadline under the assumed worst case. At a bias of 1.95, which is 4.2 percent above the maximum of five observations, 6 of 6 deferrals miss, with a worst overrun of 0.1058 s. n = 5 cannot characterise that tail.

GATE_A_dry_s4_report.GATE_A_VERDICT: STOP AND REPORT. NO CELLS POSTED.
GATE_A_REASONS: item 4 is material: the 0 of 6 is an arithmetic identity of the safety-factor choice, and it flips to 6 of 6 at a bias 4.2 percent above the maximum of the five observations the factor is derived from. The pre-registration forbids passing this gate on a tautology, and the ruling says to stop when in doubt rather than to pick a threshold that lets the run proceed.
item 3 cannot be satisfied by a dry cell at all: there is no engine-reported u, and the telemetry half of the pricing correction is constant at zero without an engine.
GATE_A_dry_s4_report.WHAT_IS_NOT_BEING_DONE_AND_WHY: the safety factor is NOT being raised to buy margin. Raising it pushes the latest safe start earlier, which shrinks every deferral and drives the deferral count toward zero, so it would trade a self-inflicted loss for an absent mechanism, and it would be a parameter changed after seeing the result. MARGIN_CF is not widened either. The options are named for the user and none is taken unilaterally: (a) accept and post, on the record that the margin is zero; (b) re-derive the factor at the same q90 from MORE committed rung-3 sent rows, which is a better measurement of the same quantity from the same base cells rather than a new method, but which does change a pre-registered number after the result is visible; (c) give the deferral a floor on the slack it must retain, which is a DESIGN CHANGE and so is a stop under the standing instruction rather than something to build.
